help.app: A utility for downloading SOOP VOD content.
help.quality:
Sets target video quality.

If requested quality does not exist, highest available quality will be used.

Options: 1440p, 1080p, 720p, 540p, auto
help.config:
Use pre-configured configuration file.

Creates a new config file if there isn't any.
help.ffmpeg: Sets the path to the ffmpeg.exe used for output.
help.batch:
Runs in batch mode.

Reads URLs from a .txt file.

See README.md for the file format.
help.keep:
Keeps temporary files.

When set, temporary files are not deleted after download.
help.merge:
Runs in list-file merge mode.

Cannot be used with any other options.
help.lang:
Sets the runtime language (locale identifier). 

Uses system locale by default, e.g. ko_KR, en_US.
cli.force_quit: Press Ctrl+C to force the program to exit.
quality.fallback: Automatically switching to the highest quality.
